description: Source code for a tool that reads TFFS partitions on NAND flash in AVM Fritz!Box devices, including functions for reading sectors, parsing entries, and handling key-value storage.

methods.name: read_uint8
methods.description: Reads an 8-bit unsigned integer from buffer at specified offset.

methods.name: read_uint32
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit unsigned integer from buffer at specified offset, with optional byte swapping.

methods.name: read_uint64
methods.description: Reads a 64-bit unsigned integer from buffer at specified offset, with optional byte swapping.

methods.name: read_sector
methods.description: Reads a sector from NAND device at specified position.

methods.name: read_sectoroob
methods.description: Reads out-of-band data for a sector from NAND device.

methods.name: get_walk_size
methods.description: Calculates size to walk over an entry, aligned to 4 bytes.

methods.name: print_entry_value
methods.description: Prints the value of a key-value entry to stdout.

methods.name: find_entry
methods.description: Finds and reconstructs a key-value entry by ID from NAND sectors.

methods.name: parse_key_names
methods.description: Parses key names from a name table entry.

methods.name: show_matching_key_value
methods.description: Displays value for a specific key name filter.

methods.name: check_sector
methods.description: Checks sector health based on OOB data if enabled.

methods.name: check_block
methods.description: Validates a block by checking its header and sector health.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the tool.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for the tool, orchestrates reading and displaying TFFS data.
